title: You DON'T Have to Identify Yourself to the Police (Except In THESE Cases)
summary: Virginia defense attorney explains when you must identify yourself to police: drivers and air travellers yes, pedestrians in Virginia no.

assertions.quote: if a police officer stops you, you must provide them with your license and your registration
Twenty-four states in this country have laws that say you must provide your identification when stopped by the police.

verdicts.note: Roughly half the states have stop-and-identify laws upheld in Hiibel; the rest impose no general duty on pedestrians.

assertions.quote: you absolutely cannot lie to the police.

verdicts.note: Every state criminalizes false identification to officers, separately from any duty to identify.
